source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 20.1, ultrasound and the piezoelectric effect (PDF 157-158).

blocks.text: Ultrasound medical imaging ka bohat istemal hone wala, non-invasive (jism ko kaate ya andar kuch daale baghair) tareeqa hai. Is se body ke andar ke hisse, jaise tissues, organs (aza) aur pregnancy (hamal) mein fetus (pet mein bachcha), dekhe ja sakte hain. Yeh piezoelectric effect naam ke physics ke principle (usool) par chalta hai, jo ultrasound transducer (probe) ke kaam ki basis (bunyad) hai. Transducer do kaam karta hai: ultrasound waves banata bhi hai aur body ke andar se wapas aane wale (reflected) signals detect (pakarna) bhi karta hai.
Lafz "piezoelectric" Greek lafz "piezein" se bana hai jis ka matlab hai "to press" (dabana), aur "electric" ka matlab bijli (electricity) paida hona.

Yeh effect 1880 mein do French scientists, Pierre Curie aur Jacques Curie, ne discover (daryaft) kiya. Woh quartz, tourmaline aur Rochelle salt (sodium potassium tartrate) jaise crystals par experiments (tajurbe) kar rahe the. Unhon ne dekha ke in crystals ko mechanical pressure se dabane par electric charge paida hota hai. Yani kuch crystals mein mechanical force aur electrical response (bijli wala jawab) ka gehra connection (talluq) hai. Yeh effect kuch crystals ki khaas internal structure (andar ki banawat) ki wajah se hota hai. Piezoelectric effect ki do types (qismein) hain: direct aur converse. In crystals ka koi centre of symmetry (aisa beech ka nuqta jis ke dono taraf banawat bilkul ek jaisi ho) nahi hota, aur in ke andar positive aur negative charge ke chhote hisse (regions) hote hain. Aam halat mein yeh charges balanced (barabar) rehte hain. Dabane par yeh balance bigar jata hai, charges thora khisakte hain aur surface par electric field ban jata hai. Ise direct piezoelectric effect kehte hain. Ulta, agar crystal par electric field lagayein to us ki shape (shakal) thori badal jati hai. Ise converse (ulta) piezoelectric effect kehte hain. Is ka kaam Fig. 20.1 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit!
blocks.text: Piezoelectric effect se pressure ko voltage mein aur voltage ko pressure mein badla ja sakta hai. Isi tarah ultrasound body se "baat" karta hai: probe voltage se awaz ki waves bhejta hai aur wapas aane wali waves ko voltage mein badal kar pakarta hai.

blocks.alt: Do metal plates ke darmiyan PZT (lead zirconate titanate) ki patli slab ko oopar aur neeche se block arrows (mote teer) dabate hain. Slab ke oopar plus (positive) aur neeche minus (negative) charges nazar aate hain. Ek wire dono plates ko jorti hai, jis par bijli ka nishan aur label 'Voltage' hai. Label: Compressing produces electricity.
blocks.caption: Figure 20.1: piezoelectric effect ka schematic diagram (saada khaaka) (kitab ki Figure 20.1 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Crystal (PZT) ko dabane se oopar positive aur neeche negative charge jama hote hain aur dono metal plates ke darmiyan voltage paida hota hai: yeh direct piezoelectric effect hai. Ulta, voltage lagane se crystal ki shape thori badalti hai (converse effect); ultrasound probe isi se waves banata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 20.1 mein label 'Led Zircoante Tianate' chhapa hai. Sahi naam Lead Zirconate Titanate (PZT) hai; yeh piezoelectric crystal ka material hai. Hamari drawing mein sahi naam likha hai.

blocks.prompt: Direct aur converse piezoelectric effect mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Direct effect mein crystal par mechanical pressure (dabao) voltage paida karta hai. Converse effect mein lagaya gaya voltage (electric field) crystal ki shape badalta hai; is liye alternating voltage crystal ko vibrate (thartharana) karata hai aur ultrasound waves banti hain.

items: Ultrasound transducer piezoelectric effect par chalta hai: waves banata bhi hai aur pakarta bhi.
Piezoelectric effect (Pierre aur Jacques Curie, 1880): bina centre of symmetry wale crystals (quartz, tourmaline, Rochelle salt).
Direct: pressure se surface par electric field (voltage); converse: electric field se crystal ki shape badalti hai.
